title: Find a grant near you
description: A real visit to the selected historical grants collection. No amounts or answers are fabricated or hard-coded into captions.

steps.caption: What grant funding is recorded near you?
Search for a place or project.
See the verified project site on the map.
Choose a pin to see what the grant was for.
Check the award amount and publication date.
Open the evidence behind the mapped location.
Follow the link to the original funding record.
